title: Your first breakpoint
summary: Freeze the program on a line and look at every variable.

say.never: A **debugger** lets you pause a running program on any line you choose, like pausing a video. While it's paused you can see the value of every variable. Then you move forward one line at a time and watch what changes.
say.bit: A debugger pauses the program on a line you pick, so you can look at every variable and move one line at a time.

marks.label: a breakpoint here pauses every time round

say.never: A **breakpoint** is where the program pauses. Click in the narrow space just **left of a line number** and a **red dot** appears. When the program reaches that line, it stops *before* running it. Click the dot again to remove it.
say.bit: Click left of a line number for a red dot: the program stops before running that line.

marks.label: the breakpoint: click left of the line number

say.never: The program is now **frozen**. The **yellow line** is where it stopped. Careful: the yellow line has **not run yet**. It's the *next* thing the program will do. Nothing moves until you tell it to.
say.bit: Frozen. The yellow line is next to run; it hasn't run yet.

say.never: This little bar appeared at the top when debugging started. Its buttons control the frozen program. Rest your mouse on any button to see its name. Use these buttons, not the F-keys: in a browser, F5 reloads the whole page.
say.bit: This toolbar controls the frozen program. Use the buttons, not F-keys.

say.never: **Continue** (the ▷ with a bar) unfreezes the program. It runs until it reaches a breakpoint again, then freezes again.
**Step Over** (the curved arrow) runs **just one line**, then freezes again. It's how you go through code slowly and watch each change.
**Stop** (the square) ends the program right away. Use it when you've seen enough.

On the left is the **Run and Debug** panel. Its first section, **Variables**, lists every variable and its value *right now*, at the frozen moment. (If you can't see it, click the bug-and-triangle icon in the bar at the far left.)
say.bit: **Variables** (left, in Run and Debug) shows every value right now.

say.never: **Local** means "the variables inside the method we're frozen in". It starts closed. Click the little **>** next to **Local** to open it.
say.bit: Click the **>** next to **Local** to open it.
